_comment: Grade 1 Unit 3 (What do we know about jobs?) exercises only 7 of Stage 1's 18 Cambridge sub-strands as extracted from the source pack. These four additions close Interpreting data (1Ad), Personal contribution (1Fc), Teamwork (1Ft) and Engaging in teamwork (1Ct) with new Activity Sheet pages in Leila's own voice, matching the unit's existing style and its workplace role-play group project. Added 2026-09-17 to close a documented coverage gap.

addExplainers.title: Our class jobs pictogram
addExplainers.body:
Look at this simple picture chart. It shows the job that each of your classmates wants most: teacher, doctor, or shopkeeper.

Count the pictures in each row with your grown-up. Which job has the most pictures? Which has the fewest?

Talk about why you think that job might be the most popular.
bullets: Count the pictures for each job.
Say which job has the most, and which has the fewest.

addExplainers.title: My job in our workplace
addExplainers.body:
Think back to your workplace role play with your group. What job did YOU do to help the group?

Maybe you were the shopkeeper who served the customers, or the doctor who checked on a patient, or the teacher who read the story.

Say it out loud: 'I helped our workplace by ...'
bullets: Remember your job in the role play.
Finish the sentence: 'I helped our workplace by ...'
Tell your grown-up what you did.

addExplainers.title: A friend's good idea
addExplainers.body:
Now think about a friend in your group. What did they do that helped the workplace?

Maybe they made the price list, or thought of a new customer to visit, or helped tidy up at the end.

Say it out loud: 'My friend helped our workplace by ...'
bullets: Remember what a friend did in the role play.
Finish the sentence: 'My friend helped our workplace by ...'
Tell your grown-up what they did.

addExplainers.title: Being a good workmate
addExplainers.body:
A good workmate is kind and helpful. Read each line with your grown-up and tick the ones you did in your role play.

Being a good workmate makes the whole workplace happier, not just faster.
bullets: I said please and thank you.
I helped a friend who needed it.
I listened when someone else was talking.
